title: Punpun River Breaches Banks, Flooding Threatens Patna Villages
summary: The Punpun River in Patna has exceeded its danger mark, leading to a breach in its ring embankment. A section of road near Baraiyako Panchayat has subsided, and 70-75 houses are under threat of flooding. Villagers are reportedly keeping vigil overnight. The breach has caused alarm in the affected areas.
summary_points: The Punpun River's water level has risen above the danger mark.
A ring embankment of the Punpun River in Patna has breached.
A road near Baraiyako Panchayat has subsided.
70-75 houses are at risk of flooding.
Villagers are monitoring the situation overnight.
